name: Guangdong Huate Gas Co., Ltd
summary: Guangdong Huate Gas Co., Ltd engages in the production and supply of gas and gas equipment in China, and internationally. It offers perfluoropropane/octafluoropropane; hexafluoro and butadiene; germane gas; nitrous oxide; hydrofluoric acid; ammonia solution; acetone; liquid helium; xenon; krypton; sulfur hexafluoride; ethylene; carbon monoxide; ethylene oxide; methane; helium; difluoromethane; neon; tetrafluoromethane; octafluorocyclobutane; hexafluoroethane; argon; nitrogen; disilane; oxygen; and carbon dioxide.
